releaseName: Lokify v1.5.0 – Official Google Account Chooser & Secure Architecture
changelog: Official Google Account Chooser: Seamless 1-tap sign-in with Google official account selector dialog on Web and native Android AccountManager chooser.
Clean Authentication: Removed double email prompt, cancellation dismisses smoothly without error banners, and duplicate request protection.
High-Accuracy GPS: Hardware GPS location provider with real-time satellite fixes and multi-provider geocoding.
Security Hardening: Removed exposed API keys and migrated to secure environment configuration.
